name: pi-promptimize
description: /promptimize for the pi and oh-my-pi coding agents: turn a rough prompt into an optimized one (small, medium or large) in a popup, after a short interview

model.description: Model for the popup, as provider/id (e.g. anthropic/claude-opus-4-8). Default: the session model.

includeContext.description: Tick "Include recent session context" by default (costs tokens).
